escalation_note: one 900 dpi tight --value crop on p26 row 1's amount cell to prove the measured row band before relying on the frame; it reproduced the printed 695 with the superscript cents.

26.measure_note: ROTATED landscape sheet: the printed ROW separators are the VERTICAL rules and the column separators the horizontal ones, so axis='x'. Column rules measured by dark-run projection over the table's x-extent (12-82% of width) and stable at every coverage threshold 0.35-0.85: 5.35 / 15.58 / 33.60 / 43.85 / 87.33 / 95.10 = Amount | Purpose | City | Person-or-Organization | Date. cell = the Amount band [5.35,15.58]. Row rules measured over the table's y-extent (6-95%) at coverage 0.35; 21 of 23 were detected directly and TWO (35.10, 38.06) were extrapolated on the grid's constant ~2.98 pitch across the one detection gap (32.12 -> 41.10). Row 1's band was PROVED with a 900 dpi make_snippet --value crop at pct:15.51,5.35,4.48,10.23@p26, which reproduced the printed amount; no transcribed row falls in the extrapolated span.

expenditures.note: the form's separate City column reads 'Ogden'; Form B has no field for it in the row contract, so it is recorded here rather than folded into the vendor name. Amount is written '695' with a superscript '00' cents.

notes: Scott K Jenkins, County Commissioner Seat B, 2018 cycle — handwritten 3-line form, January-7th-2019 final-report box ticked, signed 12-30-18. CONTRIBUTIONS: the Form A page (p25) EXISTS and is entirely BLANK — every printed row empty — with a handwritten '0 -' in its 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report)' box, matching the cover's line-1 This-Report cell written '-0'. That is an empty-schedule (the filer entered nothing), NOT a missing page and NOT an untranscribed one; the zero glyphs are quoted here verbatim and no row was invented. The cover's line-1 cumulative 11,426.61 equals the Totals-from-Last-Report column unchanged. EXPENDITURES: Form B (p26) carries exactly one printed entry. The cover's line-3 'this report' cell is written 695.00 as a POSITIVE though the balance decreases by that amount (2,918.09 -> 2,223.09) — the filer's own sign convention, retained (also flagged in the 2026-08-01 totals cache). Candidate street address and phones printed on the cover are deliberately NOT carried (PRIVACY.md).
